{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsorlift agitator''' was a key component on [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]], necessary to allow the vehicles to operate safely in [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]]. However, they could be loosened to improve the cloud car's maneuverability in less dangerous [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]].
